dvips and the Kpathsea library compiled into it

tex/vendor/dvips/dvips.wasm is TeX Live's dvips with the Kpathsea library, built by
tex/build_tools.sh from texlive-source at f6b450440fca5d39f069f1d43153f7a8a75b04a1. dvips is under the
GNU GPL (Tom Rokicki's original files are public domain), Kpathsea under the GNU LGPL 2.1 or later;
the LGPL asks that a program using the library say so and carry the library's license, which this
file and LICENSES/LGPL-2.1.txt do. Emscripten's libraries in it: emscripten.txt.

The license texts these notices refer to that are not copied below (the GNU GPL, LGPL and
AGPL, the Mozilla Public License 2.0, the Apache License 2.0 and the Artistic License 2.0) are in
LICENSE and LICENSES/ and, in the built page, earlier in LICENSES.txt. SOURCES.md says where the
exact source of each part is. Apart from the headings and the lines that say what each part is
and what its license asks, everything below is copied from the file named under its heading;
comment markers are removed.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
dvips
GPL-2.0-or-later (the parts written for the FSF); public domain (Tom Rokicki's files).
Copied from: texlive-source f6b4504, texk/dvipsk/README
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Dvips is free software; Tom's original files are public domain.  The
files Karl wrote (originally for the Free Software Foundation) are
covered by the GNU General Public License -- see the files COPYING*.
